division.heading: Actions Started by Statement of Claim

operative_text.controlling:
3.48   A plaintiff in an action in which a third party claim is filed
may apply to the Court for an order under rule 3.68 with respect to
the third party claim.

commentary.text: The plaintiff is entitled to apply under rule 3.68 in relation to any aspect of a third party claim. This permits a plaintiff to attack such issues as causes of action, jurisdiction, and other infirmities that may exist in the third party claim.
